result.topic_en: Draft for the Dirichlet-principle part of the theory of complex functions: a function that is constant a in a small circle, decays logarithmically in an annulus and is 0 outside has Dirichlet integral 2πa²/log(1/r), which can be made arbitrarily small; this forces the minimum theorem to exclude discontinuities removable at isolated points. The lower half, written upside down and headed 19, is an earlier draft on minimizing Dirichlet-type integrals over a surface T.
